window-bg.$description: System Settings panel gray; kit-27 swatch Window Backgrounds/Light Background is #FFFFFF (content-area white) — panel gray kept for control canvases

control-bg.$description: Mirrors NSColor.controlBackgroundColor — background of content areas (lists, tables). Not the button bezel — use `control` for bezels

control.$description: Bezel fill of push buttons and toggles, mirrors NSColor.controlColor

control-button.$description: Neutral button bezel; identical to control in light appearance

control-button-opaque.$description: Resolved Tahoe neutral button bezel for controls rendered over detailed backdrops

segmented-container.$description: Kit-26 segmented container = neutral control fill; kit 27 shows 0.08 — kit 26 wins

control-disabled-strong.$description: Kit unchecked-disabled fill (0.04) at 2×: consumers are additionally dimmed by disabled-opacity 0.5, so the effective fill matches the kit

progress-bar-track.$description: Kit-26 linear progress track = switch/slider track contract

group-box.$description: Kit Group Box fill: Fills/Light/4 Quaternary, radius 12

accent-hover.$description: unverified. The Tahoe kit has no hover for bordered controls

accent-pressed.$description: Kit pressed overlay on accent toggles: rgba(0,0,0,0.15)

accent-pressed-soft.$description: Kit pressed overlay on prominent buttons and filled tracks: rgba(0,0,0,0.08)

segmented-on-pressed.$description: Kit-26 pressed selected segment: accent + black 15% overlay

accent-disabled-strong.$description: Accent 50% for controls that are additionally dimmed by disabled-opacity 0.5 — effective 25% as in the kit

focus-ring.$description: Kit focused-field ring: accent 25% (verified for fields, kit 26); reused for buttons/toggles — unverified, the kit has no focus masters for them

focus-ring-border.$description: Kit focused-field hairline: accent 15%, 1px outside (verified for fields, kit 26)

label-on-accent-disabled.$description: Kit light keeps the label fully white on a disabled prominent bezel; dark dims it to 0.5

destructive-bg-pressed.$value: color-mix(in srgb, color-mix(in srgb, var(--macvue-destructive) 25%, transparent), black 15%)
destructive-bg-pressed.$description: Approximation of the kit pressed stack: destructive 25% + rgba(0,0,0,0.15) overlay

separator-on-control.$description: Kit-26 segmented separator: Light Vibrant 5 Quinary

separator-vibrant.$description: Solid separator on vibrant surfaces (kit-26 stepper: Light Vibrant 3 Tertiary; kit 27 shows 4 Quaternary #D9D9D9 — kit 26 wins)

material-menu-bg.$description: Stable native menu material; deliberately separate from experimental Liquid Glass

material-glass-regular-bg.$description: Liquid Glass Light/Regular - Medium top fill

material-glass-regular-opaque-bg.$description: Opaque accessibility fallback for the regular material

material-glass-regular-shadow.$value: inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2), inset 0 1px 2px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.7), inset 0 -1px 2px rgb(26 26 26 / 0.15)
material-glass-regular-shadow.$description: Regular rim without a separate drop shadow

material-glass-clear-bg.$description: Liquid Glass Light/Clear top fill for media-rich backdrops

material-glass-clear-opaque-bg.$description: Opaque accessibility fallback for the clear material

material-glass-clear-shadow.$description: Clear material keeps a lighter fill and a distinct rim without a drop shadow

shadow-switch-thumb.$description: Practical subset of the kit-26 knob shadow stack (speculars omitted)

switch-thumb.$description: Live-system eyedrop #DFEBFF over accent ≈ white 0.87; kit-26 stack flatten confirmed, kit-27 'solid white' rejected

slider-knob.$description: Live-system eyedrop: solid white, unlike the translucent switch knob

spinner-color.$description: Kit-27 spinner blades: monochrome black, per-blade opacity 0.55→0.06
